scenario: The ego vehicle performs an optional lane change on a multi-lane straight road to optimize driving conditions.

ego.behavior: The car changes from its initial lane to an adjacent lane and continues traveling straight forward.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight forward in its lane, maintaining its position to the left of the ego vehicle throughout the sequence.

spatial_relation: On a straight multi-lane highway, the ego vehicle starts in the right lane while an adversarial car is positioned in the left lane, traveling parallel to the ego.
requirements_and_restrictions: The lane change is optional and not required for safety; the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle completes the lane change and stabilizes in the new lane.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the red car from top-down view; the white/black car is the adversarial. 2. Chronology: Initially ego is in right lane with adversarial in left lane. Midpoint ego drifts left toward adversarial lane. Ending ego settles in left lane, both cars continue straight. 3. Evidence: Ego's lateral position shifts left across lane markings; adversarial maintains constant lane position relative to road markings.
